summary: Fully verified the new Font Fidelity Preview dialog (PngExportPreview) before PNG/ZIP export in the Composer. Single-slide PNG flow: [data-testid=composer-slide-download] opens [data-testid=png-export-preview] with side-by-side [data-testid=png-export-compare] showing live VisualCard vs [data-testid=png-export-image] (fonts visually matched — 'Bobby Jones Soft' rendered identically in both panes). Confirm ([data-testid=png-export-confirm]) triggered actual PNG download ('5-quiet-productivity-shifts-for-moms-1.png') and closed the dialog. Cancel/Close ([data-testid=png-export-cancel], [data-testid=png-export-close]) closed the dialog without any download. All-slides flow on a 7-slide carousel: [data-testid=composer-slide-download-all] opened [data-testid=png-export-grid] with 7 thumbnails ([data-testid=png-export-thumb-0..6]); clicking a thumbnail opened [data-testid=png-export-zoom] and clicking the overlay closed it; confirm downloaded the ZIP ('5-quiet-productivity-shifts-for-moms-slides.zip'). Sanity: Home dashboard renders correctly (NOT a black screen — main agent's screenshot_tool artefact only), Library page loads with all data-testids intact, backend /api/stats returns 200. No regressions surfaced.
critical_code_review_comments: Composer.jsx is ~2996 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into smaller feature modules (download/png, generation, scheduling, plan mode). Not blocking.
PngExportPreview.jsx confirmPngPreview() re-implements filename slug logic that also lives in downloadSlide flow paths — small DRY opportunity if more surfaces adopt the same dialog.
In downloadAllSlides(), the 260ms fixed wait for the card to re-render slide i is a race hazard on slower environments; consider waiting on a data-attr like `data-slide-active` before rasterising.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing 7-slide carousel draft '5 Quiet Productivity Shifts for Moms').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Font fidelity preview dialog fully passes. Composer must be entered via clicking a draft on Home (uses location.state.postId), NOT via URL query param — direct navigation to /composer?id=... opens a blank composer. All PNG/ZIP export data-testids listed in the review request are wired correctly. The 'black screen' concern from the main agent is a screenshot_tool artefact (backdrop-filter/OKLCH interaction with headless capture) — the app renders normally in real browsers.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Main agent's black-screen screenshots were caused by their tool's rendering path, not by the app.
